name: PCI DSS 4.0
description: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard controls for environments that store, process, or transmit cardholder data. Short original summaries.

requirements.title: Network security controls
requirements.summary: Firewalls and segmentation isolate cardholder environments from untrusted networks.

children.title: Restrict inbound and outbound traffic
children.summary: Network rules deny untrusted traffic by default and block open administrative ports.

children.title: Isolate cardholder data network
children.summary: Public-facing workloads cannot connect directly to cardholder storage subnets.

requirements.title: Secure configurations
requirements.summary: All system components run hardened baseline settings with no vendor defaults.

children.title: System hardening standards
children.summary: Servers, databases, and cloud buckets follow documented hardening templates.

requirements.title: Protect stored account data
requirements.summary: Retention is minimized and stored cardholder data uses strong cryptography.

children.title: Data retention and disposal
children.summary: Stored account data is purged automatically once business retention ends.

children.title: Encryption of stored PAN
children.summary: Primary account numbers are unreadable at rest using managed encryption keys.

requirements.title: Protect data in transit
requirements.summary: Strong TLS cryptography guards cardholder data across open networks.

children.title: Strong transport encryption
children.summary: External endpoints enforce modern TLS with trusted certificates.

requirements.title: Secure systems and software
requirements.summary: Vulnerabilities are patched within SLA and production changes are peer-reviewed.

children.title: Security vulnerabilities managed
children.summary: Critical and high vulnerabilities are tracked and remediated inside policy windows.

children.title: Change control for software
children.summary: Production code changes undergo independent review and approval before release.

requirements.title: Access and strong authentication
requirements.summary: Least-privilege access and MFA protect every interactive and administrative session.

children.title: Role-based access and reviews
children.summary: Access is granted by job role, reviewed periodically, and revoked upon departure.

children.title: Multi-factor authentication
children.summary: MFA is enforced for all access into the cardholder and cloud control plane.

requirements.title: Logging, testing, and governance
requirements.summary: Audit trails, penetration tests, incident response, and security policies remain active.

children.title: Audit log capture
children.summary: Cloud and system audit logs capture user actions and administrative changes.

children.title: Vulnerability scanning and pentests
children.summary: Regular vulnerability scans and annual penetration tests verify perimeter defenses.

children.title: Information security policy and training
children.summary: Written security policies, vendor oversight, and annual staff awareness remain current.
